turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a call at 4:40, so let's not waste the time. Who decided on the zero, and did anyone speak to Owen before it went in?
I appreciate you coming in with an open mind.
Don't manage me, Hale. I came in for answers, not an open mind. Procedure 4.2 says a parent is contacted before any mark goes in, and nobody called me.
A lot of parents in your position would have gone straight to the principal. You didn't. That says a lot about you.
I haven't ruled the principal out, Hale. You have until I'm out of this chair to tell me why the zero went in before anyone called me.
So I'd like to keep this between us and keep it friendly. Deal?
No deal. I'm writing down that you asked me to keep this between us, and I'll be putting everything in an email afterward. Now, what do you have on Owen's essay besides the checker?
